podcast.body: Pat Benatar, known for her album rock radio presence, kicked off 1984 with this post-disco club rock hybrid, which became a number five hit. Its accompanying video was notable for featuring Benatar leading a troop of dancers in a "syncopated shimmy," demonstrating her embrace of visual and dance elements. "She kicked off 1984 with a post-disco club rock hybrid, whose video featured Benatar leading a troop of dancers in a syncopated shimmy. The number 5 hit, Love is a battlefield."

podcast.body: This hit from late 1983 by Pat Benatar is noted for sounding "not far removed from Madonna's earlier single Burning Up." Unlike Madonna, however, Benatar remained a fixture on rock radio, which allowed her to achieve mainstream rock credibility. "Those late 83 hit, Love Is a Battlefield, doesn't sound far removed from Madonna's earlier single Burning Up."
